named_subject: a giraffe head and neck seen close up, with two horn knobs, an ear flag, an eye mark and a long snout
action: The giraffe head holds almost still while the snout slowly shortens and drops a little and the jaw and neck lines shift downward; the mouth never opens.
identity_gap: The head uses the same strokes as the doodle (flag horn, P-shaped horn, arrow eye, rounded snout with chin line, triangular jaw), but the neck is cropped and the long neck with its crossing lines from the doodle is missing.
notes: The film shows the giraffe chewing with its mouth opening, lips moving and tongue showing, while the animation only drifts the snout and jaw outline, with small jumps in the neck and jaw lines at frames 5, 9 and 13. The change that would help most is to open and close the mouth line in time with the film's chewing.
